caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped picture frame centered on a plain, light beige background. The frame is depicted in a dark reddish-brown color, resembling polished wood, and features carved decorative elements which include flower and foliage clusters at the top, sides, and bottom. The inner edge of the frame is lined with a thin, gold-colored ornamental border. The center of the frame is empty, showing only the background through it, and there are no additional objects or markings in the composition outside of the frame.
title: Elliptical Picture Frame
